headline_item.title_zh: Joby Aviation实现全自动驾驶跨洲飞行测试
headline_item.title_en: No Pilots. Few Air Traffic Controllers. What Could Go Wrong?
headline_item.event_summary_zh: Joby Aviation通过无人干预的塞斯纳大篷车飞行测试，验证了人工智能在复杂民航环境下的自动驾驶可靠性
headline_item.event_summary_en: Joby Aviation successfully completed a 3,200-mile cross-country flight from California to North Carolina without human control intervention, covering complex airspace navigation and storm avoidance. Although a safety pilot was on board for contingency, the flight demonstrated the maturity of autonomous aviation systems and marked a critical milestone in AI-driven flight control.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Joby Aviation（航空技术公司）在美国境内跨州空域：完成全程无人干预的3200英里塞斯纳单引擎涡桨飞机飞行测试
【起因与机理】验证AI在民航领域提升运营效率与飞行自主能力的商业可行性
【核心事实细节】Joby Aviation验证了民用航空器在复杂气象与密集空域下的全程自动驾驶能力。
【各方立场与态度】行业正处于从保守的人控模式向自动化系统过渡的监管与安全摩擦窗口期。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Joby Aviation (US domestic airspace): Conducted a 3,200-mile autonomous flight using a Cessna Caravan without pilot intervention
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To validate the commercial viability of AI in enhancing aviation efficiency and autonomy
[Key Fact Detail] Joby Aviation validated autonomous flight capability in complex airspace and weather conditions.
[Key Position & Outlook] The industry is entering a friction period between legacy manual control and emerging AI-driven aviation systems.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 航空工业的自动化转型已从早期的NextGen系统支持转向端到端AI实时决策，这不仅动摇了传统飞行员培训的经济模型，也对FAA（联邦航空管理局）的适航认证框架提出了严峻的合规挑战。AI在航空领域的渗透将率先在短途运输与无人货运场景打破边际成本瓶颈，但系统冗余性与不可预测的极端环境交互仍是其通过商用审批的核心技术卡点。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The transition in aviation is shifting from NextGen support systems to end-to-end AI decision-making, which disrupts traditional pilot training economic models and pressures FAA certification frameworks. While AI-driven autonomy will likely achieve initial commercial success in short-haul transport and cargo, the resolution of system redundancy and unpredictability in extreme environmental interactions remains the primary hurdle for widespread regulatory approval.

headlines.title_zh: Runway 的开源 Praxis-1 将视频 AI 转变为机器人控制器
headlines.title_en: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
headlines.event_summary_zh: AI公司Runway发布了其机器人模型Praxis-1，并开放了权重和源代码。该模型利用从视频中学到的知识来控制机器人，并在公司自己的测试中显示出有希望的结果。 Runway 发布了用于控制机器人的 AI 模型 Praxis-1
headlines.event_summary_en:
AI company Runway has released its robot model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code. The model uses what it learned from video to control robots and shows promising results in the company's own tests.

Runway has released Praxis-1, its AI model for controlling robots. The company first introduced Praxis-1 in late September but initially gave access only to select partners. Alongside the release, Runway published a detailed research report with new performance tests.

headlines.title_zh: 微软全球云服务大面积宕机完成修复
headlines.title_en: Microsoft says all Microsoft 365 products are operational, ending an outage that disrupted governments, traders, hospitals, and businesses around the world (Bloomberg)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 微软365全线产品在经历数小时全球性严重服务中断后，目前已恢复运行并实现容量稳步回升
headlines.event_summary_en: Microsoft experienced a significant global cloud infrastructure failure around November 13, disrupting critical services including Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint Online. The company implemented emergency recovery measures such as traffic throttling, route redirection, and extending email timeout thresholds to 48 hours, eventually stabilizing systems while ruling out malicious activity.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】微软公司 (Microsoft Corporation)在全球云基础设施环境：Microsoft 365及其关联组件遭遇大规模宕机，导致多国政府、医疗及企业系统瘫痪
【起因与机理】服务器处理流量能力异常，导致响应失灵，需进行紧急路由切换与容量恢复
【核心事实细节】核心受灾面：Microsoft 365全生态系统，包括Exchange Online、Teams及Copilot AI。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：排除恶意入侵可能性，正处于逐步恢复容量的稳定运营阶段。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Microsoft Corporation (Global cloud infrastructure): Major outage of Microsoft 365 and related services affecting governments and enterprises worldwide
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Server unresponsiveness under traffic load requiring emergency traffic rerouting and recovery
[Key Fact Detail] Affected scope: Microsoft 365 ecosystem including Exchange Online, Teams, and Copilot AI.
[Scope & Next Steps] Status: Malicious activity ruled out; currently in stable recovery and capacity ramp-up.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此次事件揭示了超大规模云架构在处理瞬时流量拥塞时的脆弱性，单一厂商的过度集约化部署已成为全球数字经济运行的系统性风险点。未来云服务厂商需在容灾架构中引入更细粒度的流量隔离与主动式弹性冗余策略，以降低中心化组件故障引发的级联式崩溃影响。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This incident exposes the inherent fragility of hyper-scale cloud architectures during transient traffic congestion, highlighting the systemic risk posed by over-concentration on a single provider. Future resilience strategies must prioritize granular traffic isolation and proactive elastic redundancy to prevent cascading failures across mission-critical services.

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
